title: James May and Jeremy Clarkson trying to cycle around London safely | Top Gear - BBC
description:
Subscribe and 🔔 to the BBC 👉 https://bit.ly/BBCYouTubeSub
Watch the BBC first on iPlayer 👉 https://bbc.in/iPlayer-Home Clarkson and James May are tasked with shooting a public information film to promote safer cycling. 

Along the way, the pair create some hard-hitting imagery, take a 'fact-finding' ride around the streets of London, and present their film-making efforts to an expert panel featuring bigwigs from Westminster Council and Olympic gold medal-winning cycling legend Chris Boardman.

Top Gear | Series 21 Episode 5 | BBC
